environment.isolation: Temporary homes for install, marketplace, package, lifecycle, plugin and Workspace browser gates; no user data root was read or mutated.

candidate.note: v0.6.6 hotfix candidate: four parallel worktree branches merged into release/0.6.6 — sync (#95 #97 #103 #101 #98), Web UI (#96), inject-daemon (#99 #102), git-config parser (#100) — plus the version bump, a regenerated bundle and the changelog. Gates are the fifteen docs/VERIFICATION.md §2/§4 documents at this SHA, run sequentially on the main checkout (not a worktree), bracketed by the read-only real-root isolation check. Every gate passed on its first attempt.

reviewRemediation.source: external post-release Codex review (gpt-6-astra, low reasoning) of git diff v0.6.2..main, 9 findings, each verified and reproduced on a temporary data root by an Opus verification agent before filing (#95–#103)

fixed.#95: archive export no longer publishes into the shared folder (private staging in the data root; exportForSync({syncDir}))
fixed.#96: Core.pinned() reentrant; tier/mutate refuse 409 during sync
fixed.#97: archive dry-run never creates or migrates the DB; no-index machines are refused
fixed.#98: own device alias is part of durableStateFingerprint()
fixed.#99: retire is a yield; bind failures logged (InjectDaemonBindFailed) and armReacquire; doctor reports socket path too long
fixed.#100: git config parsed as git does (quotes, subsections, include/includeIf, last wins) with a git oracle test table
fixed.#101: archive output path confined by realpath, symlink final component refused, default path included
fixed.#102: atomic lock creation via link(2); unreadable lock not deleted on first sight
fixed.#103: preview applies incoming tombstones before planning facts

reviewRemediation.regressionEvidence: each fix ships with a test the agents confirmed fails on the pre-fix code (p2: 2 UI tests; p8: 15 of 30 new cases; p1/p7/p9 repro scripts; p6 order revert → updatedFacts 1 vs 0).

priorEvidence: Receipts for 0.5.0–0.6.5 are archived as docs/verification/merge-gate-pre-<version>.json; their live proofs (tier migration, daemon takeover, re-acquisition, warm start) are not repeated here.

liveInjectionYield.observedOn: the user's real data root running v0.6.0
liveInjectionYield.note: The v0.6.0 receipt recorded liveInjectionYield as NOT_PROVEN and said it would be checked after release. It was, and real sessions injected memory. This is cited as prior live evidence about v0.6.0, not as an observation of these gates: nothing in this run touched the real root, and the isolation check proves it did not. It is also not evidence that 0.6.2 still injects, since the tier code it depends on changed in between.

notProven.liveUserData: NOT_PROVEN: gates ran on isolated fixtures and temporary homes; the user data root was only snapshotted/compared.
notProven.authenticatedCodexTier: NOT_PROVEN: lifecycle-e2e ran its offline tier; no authenticated `codex exec` session was executed.
notProven.formalPluginValidator: NOT_PROVEN: `codex plugin validate` does not exist in codex-cli 0.153.4; only the isolated substitute was observed.
notProven.liveArchiveExportIsolation: NOT_PROVEN until post-release: on the user root with sync OFF, `memex sync export --archive` must leave the shared folder absent/unchanged (#95); verified after `memex update`.
notProven.liveTwoDeviceRoundTrip: NOT_PROVEN: the user will run the two-Mac archive round trip (#48).
notProven.benchmarkRefresh: NOT_PROVEN: the benchmark record is carried forward from the v0.6.0 candidate; 0.6.6 changes no scoring path.

releaseConclusion: Every gate in the list docs/VERIFICATION.md §2/§4 documents at this SHA passes on the clean v0.6.6 candidate 7b282bee, each on its first attempt: the real-root snapshot (136 files), typecheck, a build that reproduced the tracked dist/, 119 files / 1250 Vitest tests, 214 tests through the widened mjs glob, installer, marketplace, packaged runtime (memex-0.6.6.tgz, 332 files, 9 MCP tools), offline lifecycle 9/9, 150 Workspace unit tests, 22 real-Chrome Workspace probes with 0 runtime errors, isolated plugin validation, the benchmark contract, the pack dry-run and the closing real-root compare (136 files identical). The nine review findings #95–#103 are fixed with regression tests that fail on 0.6.5. Not proven here: the live #95 check on the user root (shared folder stays untouched with sync OFF) and the two-Mac round trip, both deferred to post-release validation.
